resources.string: Ceiling Scout reads screenshots and visible controls, and sends touches to Corebound while you press Run. Farming analysis and offline map recordings stay on your phone. Offline recording separately asks for Android screen-capture permission; maps are built afterward on this device. Live laptop mapping separately asks for Android screen-sharing permission and sends landscape game images to your paired laptop. It can close recognized ad controls and return from Google Play opened by an ad. Pause or Stop on the bar stops automation. It does not read passwords or make purchases. This is a personal gameplay automation tool.
